_readme: Meta titles/descriptions. Collections and pages are pushed by scripts/push-store.mjs (overrides below win over the generated defaults). The homepage entry is not reachable through the API: paste it into Online Store → Preferences → Title and meta description.

homepage.title: Bubble Sharks | Toys for Kids Aged 3–12, Big Fun, Little Prices
homepage.description: Hand-picked bath, STEM, plush, sensory and outdoor toys for ages 3–12 with honest age grades. Free US shipping over $50, 30-day returns.

bath-toys.title: Bath Toys for Toddlers and Kids
bath-toys.description: Squirters, boats and bubble makers that make bath time the best ten minutes of the day. Honest age grades, free US shipping over $50.

stem-building.title: STEM Toys and Building Kits for Kids
stem-building.description: Blocks, marble runs, science and robot kits for ages 3–12 that sneak learning into play. Free US shipping over $50.

plush-cuddly.title: Shark Plush and Cuddly Toys
plush-cuddly.description: Soft shark plush and ocean friends for bedtime and car rides. Honest age grades, 30-day returns.

under-15.title: Kids' Toys Under $15
under-15.description: Pocket-money treats and party-bag heroes, all under $15. Free US shipping over $50.

about.title: About Bubble Sharks
about.description: Why we started a small, hand-picked toy shop for ages 3–12, and what we promise on age grades, delivery and returns.

faq.title: FAQ: Shipping, Returns and Toy Safety
faq.description: Delivery times, where we ship, toy safety standards, returns and how to reach us.

contact.title: Contact Bubble Sharks
contact.description: Email support@bubblesharks.com or use the form. We answer within one business day.

shipping-returns.title: Shipping and Returns
shipping-returns.description: Free US shipping over $50, $4.95 flat under. 5–12 business day delivery with tracking and 30-day returns.
